name: Flexible Weather API
description: Integrates Drupal with external weather services via a flexible provider system.
project_description:
Back to top 

 Overview 
 Flexible weather API is the most flexible way for adding any of the weather blocks to your site!

 This module based on the Drupal plugin system that makes this completely universal. It includes default weather services and has the ability to adding any weather services that you choose.

 At the moment available the next weather services: 
 
 Open Weather Map 
 Weather Stack 
 Yahoo Weather 
 
 Back to top 

 How to use the Flexible weather API module? 
 To provide all included functionality you have to install this module using the composer:

 composer require 'drupal/flexible_weather_api:^1.0' 

 Read the documentation where described all features.

 I want to expand the functionality of this module by adding more weather services by default so patches for adding new services are welcome. Besides if you see any improvements feel free to create a feature request where we will discuss it.
